Garen.reason: Scraped as Tank. He builds and plays as a bruiser: damage-first items, a percent-health execute, no team-wide tank utility.

Kayn.reason: Both, and which one depends on the form he transforms into: Shadow Assassin is an assassin, Rhaast is a bruiser. One label cannot describe him.

Viego.reason: Scraped as Assassin. Sustains through fights and possesses rather than bursting once and leaving.

Master Yi.reason: Scraped as Assassin. Wins by sustained attack damage over a fight, not by a burst rotation.

Pantheon.reason: Scraped as Assassin. Builds bruiser and fights through damage rather than deleting a target and disengaging.

Warwick.reason: Scraped as Assassin. Lifesteal-driven duelist who wins extended fights.

Jayce.reason: Scraped as magic. His damage is attack damage in both forms; the scrape read the hammer's magic component as the whole kit.

Ezreal.reason: Scraped as magic. Attack damage carry; only his ultimate and W carry magic scaling.

Olaf.reason: Scraped Baron only. He is a standard jungle pick and the best answer in the game to a crowd-control composition, so a jungle main was never offered him.

Shyvana.reason: Played in both; the jungle is primary.
